snippet.title: Raid Haven – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM https://store.steampowered.com/app/5205660/Raid_Haven/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=raid_haven

Raid Haven is a RimWorld-inspired, wave-based strategy game with a heavier focus on combat and base defence. Build and fortify your haven to withstand 100 waves of increasingly dangerous raids. Strategically place walls, traps, turrets, and defences, equip your pawns with powerful weapons and armour, and adapt your strategy as each wave pushes you closer to the breaking point.

DISCORD https://discord.gg/RtJT2BcXKU
